description: The source dates this code September 1,2004 and applies it to Class 1 pits larger than five hectares on private land for sand, gravel, clay or marl extraction. It identifies registration, activities plans, soil conservation, reclamation/security/certification, reporting and records, plus municipal land-use acceptability. These are explicit material-extraction site constraints. Only a legal-publication URI is listed. No individual pit locations, production volumes or reclamation-performance results are described, and current legal validity is unverified. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
